Class PagePaint.Patch

java.lang.Object
org.casserole.ssh.shell.PagePaint.Patch
Enclosing class:
PagePaint
static final class PagePaint.Patch extends Object
The Patch class is one flush of terminal bytes plus the cursor landing place. The cursor cell is the InputPage cell for the cursor index.

    • Patch

      private Patch(String ansi, int rows, int cursorRow, int cursorCol)
      The constructor stores the flush text, the row count, and the cursor cell.
      Parameters:
      ansi - The text is the terminal bytes for this flush.
      rows - The row count is the number of rows in the page after the edit.
      cursorRow - The cursor row is the visual row inside that page.
      cursorCol - The cursor column is the visual column inside that page.
